title: Making AI-Enhanced Videos: Analyzing Generative AI Use Cases in YouTube Content Creation
venue: Extended Abstracts of the CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems (CHI EA ’25)
extended_summary:
This paper examines how generative AI is being used in YouTube content creation, with a focus on understanding specific use cases across the video production workflow. The authors address a gap in knowledge about where GenAI is used in the planning, production, editing, and uploading stages of creator workflows.

The study analyzes 274 YouTube how-to videos retrieved via the YouTube Data API. The videos were selected using search queries about creating or using AI-generated text, image, audio, video, and animation content, and were filtered to English-language videos with closed captions and reasonable duration bounds. The authors then used thematic analysis on 2,829 transcript segments, with multiple researchers coding GenAI use cases such as script generation, topic ideation, prompt refinement, image/video generation, voiceover creation, lip-syncing, subtitle generation, and title generation.

The paper’s main contribution is a conceptual framework organizing GenAI use cases into four phases of video creation and showing that creators already use GenAI to reduce labor across a wide range of tasks. The authors argue that these patterns raise important HCI questions about creativity and originality, prompting skills, multimodal authenticity, and transparency/disclosure. The paper is descriptive and theoretical rather than causal; it does not evaluate an educational intervention or teacher context.
quality_tier_rationale: This is a descriptive thematic analysis of 274 YouTube how-to videos, not a causal evaluation of an educational intervention. It is peer-reviewed and methodologically transparent, but it does not test outcomes experimentally or comparatively in K-12 settings.
impact_tier_rationale: The paper has no measured educational impact and no K-12 student or teacher outcome data. Its relevance is conceptual/descriptive for GenAI workflows rather than evidence of effect on learning or instruction.

interventions.use_case: Using generative AI chat tools such as ChatGPT and Gemini to support YouTube content creation tasks, especially ideation, scriptwriting, prompt refinement, avatar/voice generation, subtitles, and title generation.
